text_block_list.text:
Starting today, the summer training camp 
begins once again.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It makes me impatient. It's been 
a while... since I last felt this way.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
To think that an entire year has already 
passed since that time...
choice_data_list: It's too early to get all nostalgic.

It's still too early to stroll down memory 
lane.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because on the greatest stage, alongside 
the greatest Umamusume, ...I'm going to 
run the greatest race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Brother. Please be strict with me 
at this year's training camp, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Onee-sama. Make this year's training 
camp tough on me, okay?
—And so, the summer training camp begins!
